entries.author: NASA / International Space Station crew

entries.attribution_text: Photo: NASA / International Space Station, 30 Nov 2021 (iss066e091657). Northwest coast of Saudi Arabia, not the NEOM site
entries.rights_evidence: 2026-10-21: read https://www.nasa.gov/nasa-brand-center/images-and-media/ : "NASA content - images, audio, video ... generally are not subject to copyright in the United States ... NASA content used in a factual manner that does not imply endorsement may be used without needing explicit permission. NASA should be acknowledged as the source"; third-party material is marked as copyright protected - the image page (https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/northwestern-coast-of-saudi-arabia-red-sea/, 31 Jan 2022) carries no such mark and credits the ISS. Geography/time: caption 'The northwestern coast of Saudi Arabia on the Red Sea is pictured from the ISS as it orbited 263 miles above', iss066e091657 (Nov. 30, 2021). The caption does not name the NEOM area: the picture is used only as regional context and labelled as not the NEOM site.
entries.on_screen_label: ISS PHOTO, NW SAUDI COAST, 30 NOV 2021. NOT THE NEOM SITE
status_reasons: EXCLUDED 2026-10-21 per owner rule (credit/authorship must come from the primary source; unconfirmed = excluded). Primary page https://www.nasa.gov/image-article/northwestern-coast-of-saudi-arabia-red-sea/ gives only the image id iss066e091657 and byline NASA, no photographer and no rights statement; the NASA Earth-observations record (eol.jsc.nasa.gov) is blocked in this environment, so the individual author cannot be confirmed. EXIF text names ESA astronaut Matthias Maurer but it is a template caption of another photo ('crew running Myotones and vascular aging') and is not evidence of authorship or copyright. Not NEOM-specific. Not shown.
